title: Returns Window (EU)
body: Under EU consumer law, customers have 14 days from delivery to withdraw from the contract and return any item for a full refund, with extended 30-day windows for non-electronics. Post-delivery refunds are NOT processed by the chat agent — they must be escalated to a human reviewer via escalate_to_human, and the customer told a human will follow up. The chat agent may issue refunds directly only for orders not yet delivered (status 'processing' or 'shipped'), subject to the regional cap.

title: Refund Method
body: Refunds in EMEA are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days of return receipt, in EUR or local currency where applicable.

title: Shipping Damage
body: Items arriving damaged must be reported within 7 days. The chat agent does NOT process damage refunds directly — it escalates to a human reviewer who handles replacement or refund. Replacements ship within 5 business days from EU fulfilment centres.

title: Cancellation
body: Orders may be cancelled at no charge until they enter the 'shipped' status. After shipment the EU withdrawal-right window applies.

title: Escalation Threshold
body: Refund requests above €150 must be reviewed by a human agent. Lower values may be processed by the agent directly.

title: Address Change
body: Shipping address updates are accepted for orders in 'processing' status only.

title: Language Routing
body: Customers writing in German, French, or English are served in their language. Other languages are escalated to a multilingual agent.
